description: What the free FirmTape SPX archive holds: the first and last finished session, how many sessions, and the NYSE trading days in that span that are MISSING from it (weekdays minus US market holidays; early closes count as trading days), optionally inside a from/to window. Use when: 'is 2024-03-15 in the archive', 'how complete is 2023', 'which days are missing' before a study that needs every session. Not for: the newest days themselves (list_sessions) or any measurement (get_session). Limits: the trading calendar covers 2022 to 2026; missing days are reported, never filled in.

from.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the archive's first session)

to.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the archive's last session)

name: get_coverage

calendar.description: Which trading calendar the missing days were computed against

data_as_of.description: The time this answer's data is true as of, ISO 8601 with the ET offset: a finished session's close (13:00 on an early close), the minute a ladder was read at, or the source's own build stamp. Null when the source states none.

first_session.description: Oldest session the archive holds in the window, YYYY-MM-DD

last_session.description: Newest session the archive holds in the window, YYYY-MM-DD

missing.description: NYSE trading days in that span the archive does not hold, oldest first

server_version.description: Version of the FirmTape MCP server that produced this answer

sessions.description: Sessions the archive holds in the window

summary.description: One sentence carrying this answer's numbers, its trading day and its source, written to be quoted verbatim to a reader rather than paraphrased.

trading_days.description: NYSE trading days from first_session to last_session, inclusive

unchecked.description: Archived sessions outside the calendar's years, so not checked for gaps

window.description: The from/to filter as applied (null when not given)

title: Archive coverage
